title: Eris UI config
description: Settings for the eris-ui CLI. `eris-ui init` writes this file to the project root.

registry.description: Where components come from: a URL, or a local folder of registry JSON for development.

css.description: The global CSS file that imports Tailwind. The theme is imported next to it.

aliases.description: Import aliases written into the copied components.

paths.description: Folders the CLI copies files into, relative to the project root.
